dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Pale buff margins are clearly visible along the trailing edges of folded feathers, creating high contrast against the dark brown feather centers with moderate boundary sharpness.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A diffuse transition area where small, dark-centered feathers on the crown increase in scale into larger scalloped feathers on the mantle; no linear boundary is visible.

other_distinctive_markers: The bird exhibits a highly repetitive dorsal pattern consisting of dark, teardrop-shaped feather centers completely encased by thin, uniform pale fringes across the mantle, back, and upper-tail coverts.
